hg-home-matches.label: Matches at Lucknow in the warehouse
hg-home-matches.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
hg-home-matches.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'other' END v, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) matches, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) rr, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY v

hg-home-win.label: LSG win rate at Lucknow
hg-home-win.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
hg-home-win.filters: LSG matches with a result at the ground
hg-home-win.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END loc, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (13) OR m.team2_id IN (13)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loc

hg-series.label: Average first-innings score: Lucknow vs IPL
hg-series.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
hg-series.filters: First innings; seasons in which the ground hosted
hg-series.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, AVG(CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN i.runs END) home, AVG(i.runs) league, SUM(CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number = 1 GROUP BY year HAVING n > 0 ORDER BY year
